page.layout: One page of text, single column; running head at top with page number at right; heading IX. VULGARIUM and subheading Sanctorum below; numbered list of relics, one entry per numbered item; a signature mark "Aa 3" and a catchword-like mark "X. ṗX" at the foot. No marginal notes.

main_text.head: IX. VULGARIUM
Sanctorum.
main_text.p: 1. Hilarii, corpora duo. unum, Pictavii, apud Canonicos, ad Hilarii: alterū, Sellç in Epiro, apud Monachos.
2. Honorati corpora duo, unum Arelate: alterum, Insulæ Lyrinorum, prope Antipolin.
3. Ægidii, corpora duo. unum, Tholosæ. alterum, Aquitaniæ oppido ab Ægidio cognominato.

4. Guilielmi duo corpora. unum, in Cœnobio Aquitaniæ, cui nomen D. Guilielmi à deserto. alterum, in Holsatiâ, Ecrichenî. duo capita, ibidem in Holsatiâ unum: & in suburbio Tureni Juliacensium, apud Guilelmitanos, alterum.
7. Ferreoli corpus integrum, Uticæ in Aquitania unum: alterum, Briodæ Arvernorum.
8. Lamberti caput apud Canonicos Trevirenses, unum: alterum, Leodii:

page.notes: Page number and running head are printed at top; the foot marks "Aa 3" and "X. ṗX" are a signature and a pagination mark. Some words in the list are faint or damaged; "Sellç" and "Lyrinorum" read as printed. The "Ægidii" initial is an ornamental form.
